name: A4 塑性纸张 · 摩擦接触原型
description: 松散揉团、释放保形；纸层/桌面摩擦与逐顶点接触力记录；外部薄壳 + IPC，未标定
upstream_origin: FQ authored discrete shell and plastic hinge model; IPC Toolkit collision library
license_status: FQ implementation with IPC Toolkit dependency (MIT); previous kami solver remains MIT with attribution
viewer_status: 塑性折痕、IPC 自碰撞、纸层及桌面摩擦
逐顶点记录自接触法向/摩擦力、桌面接触力（N）
12.5 ms；更粗步长未通过本轮误差门槛
低分辨率未标定原型；无手指、无原生 MuJoCo/PhysX 柔性
limitations: Validated only for supplied loose-ball soft-spherical compression at dt=0.0125 s; dt=0.025 s exceeds 1% peak edge strain
Uncalibrated material and friction coefficients; no mesh or full trajectory timestep convergence claim
Lagged regularized Coulomb friction updated once per step, not an exact stick-slip solver
Time-based plastic relaxation and damping; still rate dependent and uncalibrated
No fingers, robot control, tearing, fiber anisotropy or moisture
Contact forces are model predictions, not calibrated sensor readings
MuJoCo/USD are static snapshots or baked playback, not native deformable dynamics
